notes.title: Early September Dev Update 🚩
notes.notes:
Hello Architects!

We’ve been busy behind the scenes, and it’s time to share some exciting updates with you. 

Under Par Golf Architect is moving steadily into its beta phase as we get closer to release, and we’ve also kicked off the porting process to bring the game to more platforms.



One of the things we’re most excited about is the demo, which will be available very soon. If you haven’t already, make sure to wishlist the game—that way you’ll get notified the moment the demo goes live!


Also, keep an eye on the upcoming PC showcases. You might just spot Under Par Golf Architect there, along with a couple of brand-new features we haven’t revealed before.


Gamescom was a truly productive milestone for us—full of hands-on feedback, conversations, and new connections. We hope to get all the things sorted and turn those Under Par opportunities into reality! 🤞
In the meantime, you can check out this preview from Gamescom: 

https://insider-gaming.com/under-par-golf-architect-hands-on-preview/

It’s a great hands-on impression of what we’ve been building.

For our French-speaking community, you may want to read this as well: 

https://jv.jeuxonline.info/actualite/65415/gamescom-2025-under-golf-architect-tycoon-ancienne


Under Par was a show stopper at the italian booth 🤩


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524161/461897bea28b63e8c02ca1c23d5b1696c6e9c6ae.jpg"]

We also want to give a huge shoutout to our communities on Reddit and Discord. You’ve been sharing ideas, feedback, and feature suggestions—and while we can’t promise everything will make it into the game, please know we’re reading and discussing all of it. If you’d like to be part of shaping the future of Under Par Golf Architect, we’d love to see you there too!


Thanks again for all your support—it means the world to us. 
We can’t wait to share more and see the creative courses you’ll design when the demo drops!



– The Broken Arms Games Team
